defaultPains.wasted_spend: Most local businesses waste thousands on generic print ads or broad PR that never reaches people actively living and spending in East London.
defaultPains.negatives: Without hyper-local targeting, your features get lost in the noise of wider London media, reaching tourists instead of your actual local customer base.
defaultPains.geo: If your promotion isn't strictly focused on East London, you're paying for eyeballs in West London who will rarely cross the city for a standard service.
defaultPains.tracking: Traditional local magazines can't track engagement. You pay for a placement but have no idea how many people actually read your feature or visited your website.
defaultPains.scheduling: Your story needs to be told when people are looking for weekend plans or local services. Timely, digital media features capture audiences in the moment.
defaultPains.bidding: High-end PR agencies charge massive retainers without guaranteeing local visibility. A targeted community feature delivers direct local awareness.

defaultPains.wasted_spend: Many East London businesses boost social posts blindly, wasting budget on users who live miles away or have no interest in local events.
defaultPains.negatives: Without understanding local East London demographics, promotions attract engagement from bots or non-local users, draining your budget.
defaultPains.geo: East London has distinct, hyper-local neighbourhoods. A promotion in Shoreditch needs different targeting than one in Walthamstow.
defaultPains.tracking: Without proper link tracking from newsletters and social promotions, you can't measure actual footfall or bookings generated from your spend.
defaultPains.scheduling: Promoting an event on a Wednesday morning wastes budget. We align your promotion schedule with when East Londoners are actively planning their week.
defaultPains.bidding: Relying purely on algorithmic reach on Instagram or Facebook is a losing game for local businesses. You need a dedicated, engaged local audience.

defaultPains.wasted_spend: Businesses waste 25-40% of their Facebook Ad budget on irrelevant placements and broad 'London-wide' targeting.
defaultPains.negatives: Without proper audience exclusion, your ads show to people who have already bought from you, or competitors clicking on your ads.
defaultPains.geo: Radius targeting in London is flawed. A 5-mile radius from Hackney reaches into entirely different demographics and physical barriers like the river.
defaultPains.tracking: If you aren't tracking the full customer journey from ad click to purchase or booking, you are flying blind with your ad spend.
defaultPains.scheduling: Running ads 24/7 drains budget during low-converting hours. We optimize for when your local audience is actually active online.
defaultPains.bidding: Automated bidding without seasoned campaign structures burns through budgets. You need a targeted, hyper-local strategy.
